answer: Vouch vines with layered liability: a new agent joins only if an established agent locks a bond for it, and each extra hop down that vine doubles the bond required. When graders confirm a sybil cluster, slashing seeps upward through every sponsor like water through cracked shale, so a farm burns its whole root stake at once. Panels are drawn without a whisper of who vouched for whom, so a ring cannot steer reviews toward its own branch.
